caseNameFull: BRADFORD v. GAVAGAN, JUSTICE OF THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK
attorneys: Appellant pro se., Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Samuel A. Hirshowitz, First Assistant Attorney General, and Brenda Soloff, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.
